Hello! It's great to see your proactive approach to security. Discussing methods of encoding sensitive information is a smart way to enhance security further.

On the other hand, ciphers can encrypt the data, making it unreadable without the proper decryption key.

By implementing these techniques, you can help safeguard sensitive information and reduce the risk of unauthorized access. If you have any specific questions or need further guidance on how to implement these methods, feel free to ask!
